record.question: A host tour is:
options: A tour in which the group has an itinerary and travels without any company representative.
An all-inclusive tour that has a specific combination of features.
A tour in which the group has a tour director travelling with the group.

A tour in which the group travels from destination to destination as a group, without a company representative. At each destination, a tour director from that city greets them and stays with them throughout their stay.
